items.text: Users found publicly shared Claude chats and Artifacts indexed by Google, exposing conversations people assumed were only link-accessible.
items.text_zh: 用户发现公开分享的 Claude 对话和 Artifacts 被谷歌收录，原本以为只能凭链接访问的内容遭曝光。

items.text: LMArena added a factuality ranking blending human preference with factual accuracy, where Claude Opus 5 with Max reasoning takes the #1 Text Arena spot.
items.text_zh: LMArena 新增结合人类偏好与事实准确度的 factuality 榜，Claude Opus 5（Max 推理）登顶文本竞技场第一。

items.text: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna xHigh variants entered Agent Arena at #15 and #17, well behind sibling Sol, which ranks top two.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Terra 与 Luna（xHigh）进入 Agent Arena，分列第 15、17 名，远落后于同门 Sol 的前二成绩。

items.text: OpenAI rolled GPT-Live in ChatGPT Voice out globally to Edu, Business, and Enterprise plans.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 将 ChatGPT Voice 中的 GPT-Live 全球开放给教育版、商业版和企业版用户。

items.text: ChatGPT now refuses direct requests to write in a named living author's style, though testers say it still reproduces a similar feel indirectly.
items.text_zh: ChatGPT 开始拒绝直接模仿指定在世作家文风的请求，但测试者称绕个弯仍能写出相似味道。

items.text: Satya Nadella warned that companies betting everything on a single AI provider may not survive, urging multi-model strategies.
items.text_zh: 纳德拉警告：把全部业务押在单一 AI 供应商上的公司可能活不下来，呼吁企业采用多模型策略。

items.text: Cursor added Kimi K3, saying it scores close to the frontier on CursorBench and runs on US-based inference from Fireworks, Together, and Baseten.
items.text_zh: Cursor 上线 Kimi K3，称其 CursorBench 成绩接近前沿模型，并通过 Fireworks、Together、Baseten 提供美国本土推理。

items.text: Moonshot released PerceptionBench, a benchmark that isolates visual perception and scores it as a set of atomic capabilities derived from real model failures.
items.text_zh: 月之暗面发布 PerceptionBench，将视觉感知单独剥离出来，按从真实模型失败中归纳的原子能力逐项评测。

items.text: Perplexity shipped pplx, a single-binary CLI exposing only web search and page fetch as strict JSON, built for coding agents rather than chat.
items.text_zh: Perplexity 推出单文件 CLI 工具 pplx，只提供网页搜索与正文抓取两条命令并严格输出 JSON，专为编程 Agent 而非聊天设计。

items.text: PixVerse added Depth Map control to its Mini Apps, letting creators drive image-to-video motion with a grayscale depth video extracted from a reference clip.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 在 Mini Apps 中上线深度图控制，创作者可用参考视频提取的灰度深度序列驱动图生视频的运镜与运动。

items.text: A judge rejected Google's attempt to use DMCA claims against a web scraper, with the winning company declaring that Google and Reddit "do not own the Internet."
items.text_zh: 法官驳回谷歌以 DMCA 条款起诉网页抓取公司的主张，胜诉方称谷歌和 Reddit "并不拥有互联网"。

items.text: LlamaIndex released create-llama-worker, a scaffold that deploys a LlamaParse document-parsing worker to Cloudflare Workers in minutes.
items.text_zh: LlamaIndex 发布 create-llama-worker 脚手架，几分钟即可把 LlamaParse 文档解析 worker 部署到 Cloudflare Workers 边缘。
